approvalBody: Customers can't book {name} until our field team approves it.
approvalBodyKirana: Customers can't order from {name} until our field team approves it. The visit is booked once all your products are added (see the counter). Your counter works meanwhile.
webViewOldBody: This phone's "Android System WebView" is too old for the app. Update it in the Play Store (it's free), then open the app again.
updateRequiredTitle: Please update the app to continue
updateRequiredBody: This version of Clozest Partner is too old. Update it from the Play Store (it's free). Your shop, bookings and settings stay as they are.
playUpdateAvailable: A new version of the app is available.
playUpdateDownloading: Getting the new version. You can keep using the app.
playUpdateReady: The new version is downloaded. Tap Restart to install it (it takes a few seconds).
fixReady: A fix for the app is ready. Save anything you're typing, then tap Restart (a few seconds; you stay on this screen).
updateRequiredHint: If the Play Store shows no update yet, close the app and try again in a few hours, or tap Check again.
